name: cameri-schematics
description: Agentic schematics — published build specifications that any LLM, team, or org can implement independently, with zero coordination with the author. The spec is the only coordination mechanism.

plugins.name: schematics
plugins.description: The authoring plugin — authors, reverse-engineers, and maintains agentic schematics: self-contained build specifications anyone can implement independently, without central coordination. Provides the create-schematic and build-schematic skills.

plugins.name: opa-docker-authz
plugins.description: Grants a sandbox container restricted Docker daemon access over TLS, policed by Open Policy Agent — certificate infrastructure, Rego policy, systemd TCP listener, and sandbox client provisioning.

plugins.name: sops-env-secrets
plugins.description: Encrypt service secrets with SOPS and age and inject them into container processes as environment variables at boot, in memory: dual-recipient encryption, a per-service key blast radius, docker-secret wiring, and rotation without rebuilds.

plugins.name: docker-socket-proxy
plugins.description: Exposes a deny-by-default Docker API to containers over an internal network — an endpoint allowlist proxy in front of docker.sock so tooling can pull images or read status without ever mounting the socket or gaining control of the daemon, with an audit script that proves the allowlist.

plugins.name: webhook-rolling-deploy
plugins.description: Self-updating Docker Compose deployments — a GitHub push webhook flows through a Cloudflare tunnel and a path-token receiver into an in-memory queue, and a worker pulls the new image through a scoped Docker API proxy. HTTP ack in milliseconds, pull in the background, no open ports, no full docker socket anywhere.

plugins.name: media-fetching
plugins.description: Privately fetching books and audiobooks - gluetun as a structural VPN kill switch with Deluge sharing its network namespace, Chaptarr automating grabs, and a companion IP-sync service for indexers that allow exactly one seedbox IP. Every UI is tailnet-only; nothing public.

plugins.name: media-serving
plugins.description: Serving a self-hosted digital library - Audiobookshelf reading the same dataset the fetching stack writes, with the public surface as a first-class choice: Tailscale serve by default, tsdproxy or a Cloudflare tunnel when you want a real hostname. Read-only by posture; the media never moves.

plugins.name: media-library
plugins.description: A composition schematic - assembles media-fetching and media-serving into one operating system for a self-hosted digital library, and defines the shared volume contract between them. No images of its own; the glue is the artifact: shared paths, isolation rules, and one grab-to-listen acceptance test.
